processes.title: Run Payroll
processes.description: Complete payroll processing workflow from period selection through report generation. This is the standard monthly payroll cycle.

steps.title: Select Pay Period
steps.description: Choose the month and year for which you want to process payroll. This determines which employees and data will be included.

steps.title: Review Employee Data
steps.description: Review all employee payroll data for the selected period. Check for errors, missing information, or discrepancies. Filter by department or status to focus on specific groups.
steps.next_step_condition: If any employee has errors → go to Fix Errors (Step 3), otherwise → go to Calculate (Step 4)

steps.title: Fix Employee Data Errors
steps.description: Correct any errors found during the review. Common errors include missing bank account numbers, invalid tax IDs, or incorrect salary amounts. After fixing, return to the review step.
steps.next_step_condition: After fixing all errors → return to Review (Step 2)

steps.title: Calculate Payroll
steps.description: Run the payroll calculation engine. This computes gross pay, deductions (tax, insurance, retirement), and net pay for all reviewed employees in the selected period.

steps.title: Preview Payroll Results
steps.description: Review the calculated payroll before confirming. Check department totals, look for anomalies, and verify that net pay amounts are reasonable.
steps.next_step_condition: If your organization requires approval → go to Request Approval (Step 6), otherwise → go to Confirm (Step 8)

steps.title: Request Approval
steps.description: Submit the payroll for managerial approval. Select the approver and add any notes about special circumstances.

steps.title: Check Approval Status
steps.description: Monitor the approval request. Once approved, proceed to confirm and post the payroll.

steps.title: Confirm and Post Payroll
steps.description: Final step: confirm the payroll run and post it to the general ledger. This action is irreversible. Enter the confirmation code sent to your email.

steps.title: Generate Reports
steps.description: Generate payroll reports for the completed period: payslips for employees, department summaries, tax reports, and bank files for direct deposit.

processes.title: Create and Send Invoice
processes.description: Create a new invoice for a client, preview it, and send it via email or download.

steps.title: Create Invoice
steps.description: Fill in the invoice details: client, date, line items, and payment terms.

steps.title: Preview Invoice
steps.description: Review the invoice before sending. Check line items, totals, tax calculations, and formatting.

steps.title: Send Invoice
steps.description: Send the invoice to the client via email or download as PDF.
